gloss: early human; archaic human (Homo erectus stage)

definitions.gloss: early human; archaic human (Homo erectus stage)
definitions.explanation: In the study of human evolution, an early human of the Homo erectus stage, more advanced than the ape-like {猿人|えんじん} but earlier than {旧人|きゅうじん} and modern humans. Often appears in the names of specific finds, such as {北京原人|ぺきんげんじん} (Peking Man).

examples.japanese: {原人|げんじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{火|ひ}→火：02248_hi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っていた→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
{北京原人|ぺきんげんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発見|はっけん}→発見：00085_hakken⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fossils of Peking Man were discovered.

examples.japanese: {原人|げんじん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{猿人|えんじん}→猿人：29452_enjin⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{進化|しんか}→進化：06029_shinka⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{位置|いち}づけられる→位置づける：16062_ichizukeru⟧。
examples.english: Archaic humans are placed at a more evolved stage than the ape-men.

notes:
Compound of {原|げん} (original, primitive) + ⟦{人|じん}→〜人：09849_jin⟧ (person). A term from paleoanthropology denoting one stage in human evolution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {北京原人|ぺきんげんじん}: Peking Man
- {ジャワ原人|ジャワげんじん}: Java Man
- {原人|げんじん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{化石|かせき}→化石：11796_kaseki⟧: fossils of early humans

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{猿人|えんじん}→猿人：29452_enjin⟧: ape-man — an earlier, more primitive stage
- ⟦{旧人|きゅうじん}→旧人：29483_kyuujin⟧: archaic Homo (e.g. Neanderthals) — a later stage
- ⟦{新人|しんじん}→新人：02500_shinjin⟧: anatomically modern humans (in this paleoanthropology sense)
